executiveSummary: The recent technology news highlights AI/ML advancements, hardware releases, and industry shifts. Meta's Muse Code AI agent is expanding its capabilities, while Apple's iCloud Private Relay service may be leaking users' real IP addresses. The trend of AI-powered products is gaining momentum.

takeaways.title: Meta expands AI coding agent
takeaways.description: Meta's Muse Code AI agent can handle complex tasks with complex software, as reported in TechCrunch and MacRumors articles.

takeaways.title: AI-powered products on the rise
takeaways.description: Several companies like Meta, X, and Lightspeed are developing AI-powered products, such as AI-generated media and autonomous vehicle fleets, according to various news sources.

worthWatching: The increasing importance of transparency in AI-generated content
The growing adoption of autonomous vehicles and robotaxis services
engineeringPerspective: The technical challenges of developing AI-powered products, such as ensuring data privacy and security.
The need for more robust testing and validation methods for AI-driven systems.
